Subject: Panel - Coastal Resilience Symposium

Hello,

The Lowcountry Resilience Lab is hosting the Coastal Resilience Symposium on September 14, 2027 in Charleston, SC. Dr. Alan Pierce will moderate a panel on insuring coastal communities, and we'd like your CEO to join it. Attendance is TBD; registration opens next month.

Regards,
Mia Duval
Program Manager, Lowcountry Resilience Lab
